selection: Biological/clinical rationale set, NOT exhaustive preclinical inception cohort

members.entry_definition: registered study start; may precede first dose or indication-specific enrollment
members.interpretation: Closest DEE/haploinsufficiency peer; early clinical signals do not equal approval.
members.why_selected: SCN1A haploinsufficiency in Dravet; pediatric DEE, seizure burden, protein restoration and intrathecal ASO delivery.
members.key_mismatch: Splicing-based restoration rather than regRNA modulation; different neuronal target and endpoints.

members.entry_definition: registered study start; may precede first dose or indication-specific enrollment
members.interpretation: Alias GTX-102. Sept pivotal miss known at Needham date; November wind-down is later confirmation. Earlier dose-related hold was subsequently lifted.
members.why_selected: UBE3A restoration in Angelman; pediatric neurodevelopment, intrathecal dosing, cognition/function assessment. Failed pivotal provides disconfirming evidence.
members.key_mismatch: Imprinted paternal allele unsilencing; three Angelman assets share disease/target and are correlated.

members.entry_definition: registered study start; may precede first dose or indication-specific enrollment
members.interpretation: Alias RO7248824. Phase III with OHB; program continuation despite original sponsor change.
members.why_selected: Same pediatric protein-restoration and clinical measurement problems; distinct ASO provides molecule-level contrast.
members.key_mismatch: Angelman/UBE3A correlation; EEG biomarker is not established SYNGAP1 efficacy surrogate.

members.entry_definition: registered study start; may precede first dose or indication-specific enrollment
members.interpretation: Aliases ION582/BIIB121. Biogen option declined, Ionis Phase III continues; do not count partner decision as failure.
members.why_selected: Protein restoration in Angelman with repeated intrathecal dosing; relevant functional and developmental trial design.
members.key_mismatch: Angelman/UBE3A correlation; positive early uncontrolled signals are not demonstrated pivotal success.

status_summary.interpretation: Selected-sample outcome bounds, NOT population PoS or confidence intervals; stops assumed permanent; no independence assumed.
